connectionSpecification.description: Writes each stream into a typed table of one schema through PUT and COPY INTO: overwrite, append or append_dedup.

account.description: Account identifier, orgname-accountname, or the account locator with its region.
account.title: Account

oneOf.description: Logs in with a JWT signed by the user's RSA private key; the user's RSA_PUBLIC_KEY must be its public key.

private_key.description: RSA private key in PEM: PKCS#8 (-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----), encrypted PKCS#8 or PKCS#1.
private_key.title: Private Key

private_key_password.description: Passphrase of an encrypted private key.
private_key_password.title: Private Key Password

username.description: Snowflake user the connector logs in as.
username.title: Username

oneOf.title: Key Pair Authentication

database.description: Database the tables are written to.
database.title: Database

role.description: Role of the session; the user's default role when empty.
role.title: Role

schema.description: Schema every table is written to, in upper case; it is created when missing.
schema.title: Default Schema

warehouse.description: Warehouse that runs the loads; the role needs USAGE on it.
warehouse.title: Warehouse

connectionSpecification.title: Snowflake Destination Spec
